bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect "$pg" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
sql="SELECT r.paid_message_id,r.status,l.price_stars,(l.paid_video_file_id=l.sample_file_id) AS same_with_own_sample,(SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_listings x WHERE x.sample_file_id=l.paid_video_file_id OR x.thumbnail_file_id=l.paid_video_file_id) AS exposed_as_free_in_any_listing,(SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_stars_ledger t WHERE t.delivery_key=r.delivery_key AND t.kind='paid') AS confirmed_paid_count FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.paid_message_id IN (4691,4701) ORDER BY r.paid_message_id;"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
